intro:
Sun's out, the pool's packed, and they're all rooting for you.
Play the minigames, earn their attention and unlock exclusive images!
description:
It's the hottest party of the summer and the guys are watching every move you make. Score big across the minigames and watch the gallery fill up with exclusive images of each character in his full pool party look.

Play hard, react fast, and hold your ground when things get intense. The boys notice everything, whether you're crushing it or just barely hanging on.

Some of them can't stop hyping you up. Others turn red every time you do something unexpected. All of them are worth getting to know better.

How deep into the gallery can you get before the sun goes down?


FEATURES:

● MINIGAMES WITH SPARK: Play through different challenges while they cheer, tease, and react to your every move.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Higher scores open up more images, more looks, more sides of each character.

● ANIME CHARACTERS WITH TONS OF PERSONALITY: From the one who never stops cheering to the one who can't hide his surprise, every reaction is part of the experience.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: The summer ends differently depending on how far you push it.

● HIDDEN FINAL MOMENT: Score high enough and find out what they've been hiding all along.


Push your score. Make them regret underestimating you.
The pool party's already started.
Get in!
